title: Luxury glass navigation + cinematic hero + dark-section consistency on Home

requirements.summary: Restyle the global header to a fully transparent, premium glassmorphism treatment with white navigation text (including mobile menu).
acceptanceCriteria: Header no longer renders with an opaque background at page top (no solid fill).
Header uses blur and subtle tint/border consistent with the provided RGBA values (or visually equivalent), and nav link text renders in white.
Desktop and mobile header states both follow the transparent glass styling (including the opened mobile menu area).

file_operations.description: Remove the current solid/dark inline header background and gold border styling; apply a reusable glass header class (transparent with backdrop blur 10–15px, subtle white tint rgba(255,255,255,0.08), thin soft border rgba(255,255,255,0.1)) and ensure nav text renders white in both desktop and mobile menu states.

Add/adjust global CSS utility classes for the premium glass header (baseline state): transparent glass background, blur, subtle border, and white text/link styling for header + opened mobile menu area.

requirements.summary: Add scroll-based header styling that subtly increases blur/opacity and adds a low-opacity deep navy/charcoal tint while remaining glassy.
acceptanceCriteria: When at top of page, header uses the baseline transparent glass style.
After scrolling down, header transitions (smoothly) to a slightly stronger blur/opacity with a subtle dark tint; it never becomes an opaque/solid bar.
Scroll state transitions are animated and do not cause layout shift.

file_operations.description: Implement a scroll position state (e.g., window scrollY threshold) to toggle a 'scrolled' header style class; ensure the transition is smooth, glassy, and does not change layout dimensions.
Define the header 'scrolled' glass variant (slightly higher blur and opacity plus a very subtle deep navy/charcoal tint) and transition properties so it remains translucent (not a solid bar).

requirements.summary: Increase the header logo size ~1.5× while keeping header alignment and navigation accessibility intact across breakpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo height/visual prominence increases ~1.5× compared to current sizing on both mobile and desktop.
Header height and spacing remain balanced; navigation remains accessible and not clipped at common viewport sizes.

file_operations.description: Adjust logo sizing classes to increase visual prominence by ~1.5× across breakpoints, and tune header inner layout (heights/padding/gaps) to prevent overlap or awkward pushing of navigation.

requirements.summary: Refine the Home hero to a crisp luxury editorial look with a sharper equestrian image, minimal overlay, and only a subtle top gradient for readability.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero background image appears sharp and not overly filtered; overlay does not significantly darken the image.
Hero overlay is limited to a subtle top gradient for readability (lighter than the current heavy overlay).
Hero still maintains adequate text contrast/readability over the image.

file_operations.description: Add the generated sharper luxury editorial equestrian hero placeholder image per imageRequirements.edits (hero-equestrian.dim_1600x900.png -> hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png) so it can be used as the Home hero background.

Swap the hero background image reference to frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png and replace the current heavy full overlay with a subtle top-only gradient that preserves crisp visibility while keeping text readable.

Reduce/remove heavy hero text panel/overlay styling (e.g., current hero text backdrop) and introduce lighter hero readability helpers (subtle text shadow and restrained gradient usage) consistent with a cinematic-but-clean editorial direction.

requirements.summary: Update hero typography and CTA styling: elegant serif headline in warm white with subtle shadow, warm-gold primary, transparent white-bordered secondary, and hover lift (no scaling).
acceptanceCriteria: Hero headline renders as an elegant serif with increased prominence and a subtle text shadow; spacing around hero elements feels more spacious than current.
Primary hero CTA uses a warm gold fill; secondary hero CTA is transparent with a white border and white text.
On hover, hero CTAs lift subtly (translateY) with smooth transitions; no aggressive scaling.

file_operations.description: Adjust .btn-primary and .btn-secondary to match requested palette (warm gold primary; transparent secondary with white border/text) and replace scale-based hover with a subtle translateY lift (2–4px) and smooth transitions; add a subtle hero headline text-shadow utility/class.
Apply updated hero typography classes (serif headline styling, warm white tone, subtle text shadow, more generous spacing) and ensure the CTA buttons use the updated primary/secondary button classes.

requirements.summary: Restyle Home highlights/features into floating glass panels over a deep navy/charcoal background with subtle hover lift and no light/beige/grey blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: The highlights/features section background is deep navy/charcoal (solid, minimal) with no additional background image.
Feature cards use the specified glass look (rgba(255,255,255,0.08) + blur + thin border + subtle shadow) and appear as floating panels.
Hover on cards lifts them by ~2–4px with smooth transition; no heavy glow or thick borders.

file_operations.description: Introduce/adjust a dark-glass card style for the highlights section to match rgba(255,255,255,0.08) background + backdrop blur + thin soft border + subtle shadow + rounded corners; tune hover lift to 2–4px (not larger).

Change the highlights/features section to a deep navy/charcoal background and apply the updated dark-glass card styling to all highlight cards; ensure no background image is introduced for this section.

requirements.summary: Make Home page section backgrounds consistently dark luxury and increase editorial spacing/typographic breathing room without changing structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page no longer alternates multiple distinct light section backgrounds (e.g., ivory/blue-tint) in a way that feels busy; overall reads as restrained dark luxury.
Section spacing is increased and consistent; content does not feel cramped.
No new sections/components are introduced; changes are styling and light layout spacing adjustments only.

file_operations.description: Adjust existing section background classes so Home reads mostly deep navy/charcoal (with restrained transparent overlays only where needed), reduce/remap light sections (ivory/blue tint) to dark equivalents, and increase vertical spacing between existing sections while keeping the same structure and content.

Refine section background utility classes (favor deep navy/charcoal) and spacing/typography defaults (slightly larger headings where needed, more vertical rhythm) to support a restrained premium editorial feel without introducing new sections.
